mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, measure_time, glucose, meal_state FROM t_blood_glucose WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_blood_glucose (user_id, device_id, measure_time, glucose, meal_state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{measureTime}, #{glucose}, #{mealState})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_blood_glucose SET user_id=#{userId}, device_id=#{deviceId}, measure_time=#{measureTime}, glucose=#{glucose}, meal_state=#{mealState} WHERE id=#{id}
